description: [Read · free] Summary stats for a Constellation campaign: target count, entry count, outreach volume, and acceptance / reply rates broken down by pool (coworker / engager / mutual) and composite-score tier. Outcomes logged for people who are not campaign entries are counted under an `unattributed` bucket in both by_pool and by_tier, so breakdowns always sum to the totals. Free — costs 0 credits.
name: get_campaign_stats
title: Get Campaign Stats
